questions.questionText: Your operations team needs to migrate 300 TB of archive data from an on-premises data center to Cloud Storage. The data center only has a 50 Mbps internet connection. Which migration tool should you advise the team to use?

explanation.general explanation: Transfer Appliance is a high-capacity hardware device that you rent from Google. It is used to securely migrate large volumes of data offline, which is the only viable option when the internet connection (50 Mbps) is too slow for a 300 TB network transfer.

why other options are wrong.Storage Transfer Service: While Storage Transfer Service has an on-premises agent, transferring 300 TB over a 50 Mbps connection would take years, making it an impractical choice.
why other options are wrong.BigQuery Data Transfer Service: BigQuery Data Transfer Service is used for importing data into BigQuery from SaaS apps or Cloud Storage, not for migrating unstructured data from an on-premises data center.
why other options are wrong.Datastream: Datastream is a Change Data Capture (CDC) service for replicating relational databases, not for moving bulk file/archive data.

questions.questionText: Your development team is migrating an application from AWS to Google Cloud. They need a fully managed tool to reliably move millions of image files from Amazon S3 to a Google Cloud Storage bucket. Which tool should you recommend?

explanation.general explanation: Storage Transfer Service is designed to quickly and securely transfer large amounts of data between external cloud storage providers (like Amazon S3 or Azure Blob) and Google Cloud Storage.

why other options are wrong.BigQuery Data Transfer Service: This service moves data into BigQuery, not into Cloud Storage object buckets.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Data Fusion: Data Fusion is an ETL tool. While it can move data, using a complex ETL tool for a straight file-copy migration from S3 to GCS is overly complicated compared to the native Storage Transfer Service.
why other options are wrong.Database Migration Service: Database Migration Service (DMS) migrates operational databases (like MySQL and PostgreSQL), not unstructured object data like images.

questions.questionText: Your team needs to migrate an existing on-premises MySQL database to Cloud SQL for MySQL. The business requires that the application experiences minimal downtime during the cutover. Which migration tool provides continuous replication to ensure minimal downtime?
options: Exporting a mysqldump file and importing it via the console

explanation.general explanation: Database Migration Service (DMS) is a fully managed service that performs continuous data replication from an source database to Cloud SQL. This continuous sync allows you to switch the application to the new database with near-zero downtime.

why other options are wrong.Datastream: Datastream is for Change Data Capture (CDC) to analytics destinations like BigQuery or Cloud Storage, not for homogenous database-to-database operational migrations.
why other options are wrong.Storage Transfer Service: This is for moving files to Cloud Storage, not relational database data.
why other options are wrong.Exporting a mysqldump file and importing: A manual dump and load requires the source database to be taken offline during the entire export, transfer, and import process, causing significant downtime.

questions.questionText: A company wants to lift and shift their entire on-premises VMware environment to Google Cloud. They do not want to refactor their VMs, change their IP addresses, or retrain their staff on new hypervisor tools. Which system migration service is the best fit?

explanation.general explanation: Google Cloud VMware Engine provides a fully managed VMware Cloud Foundation stack running on dedicated Google Cloud infrastructure. It allows organizations to lift and shift VMware workloads seamlessly without refactoring or changing IP spaces, using the exact same vCenter tools they already know.

why other options are wrong.Migrate to Virtual Machines: This tool converts VMware VMs into native Compute Engine VMs. The customer specifically requested not to change their hypervisor tools, so migrating away from VMware is not the right choice.
why other options are wrong.Bare Metal Solution: Bare Metal Solution provides physical servers primarily for specialized workloads like Oracle databases, not a managed VMware environment.
why other options are wrong.Google Kubernetes Engine: GKE requires containerizing the applications, which violates the requirement to 'lift and shift without refactoring'.

questions.questionText: You are advising a team that is migrating dozens of on-premises VMs to native Google Cloud Compute Engine instances. Which specialized tool automates the replication, testing, and cutover of these VMs into Google Cloud?

explanation.general explanation: Migrate to Virtual Machines (formerly Migrate for Compute Engine) is Google Cloud's native tool for orchestrating the lift-and-shift migration of VMs from on-premises (VMware, AWS, Azure) directly into Compute Engine instances.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Deployment Manager: Deployment Manager is an Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool for provisioning new resources, not for replicating and migrating the state of existing on-premises VMs.
why other options are wrong.Database Migration Service: DMS migrates databases, not entire Virtual Machines.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Build: Cloud Build is a CI/CD service for building code and containers, not a VM migration tool.

questions.questionText: Your team needs to migrate large volumes of unstructured data to Google Cloud Storage. Which two tools are officially recommended by Google Cloud for moving massive amounts of data from on-premises storage arrays? (Choose two)

explanation.general explanation: For moving massive amounts of unstructured data from on-premises, Google Cloud recommends Storage Transfer Service (using on-premises agents over a fast internet/interconnect connection) or Transfer Appliance (a physical device for offline transfer when bandwidth is constrained).

why other options are wrong.BigQuery Data Transfer Service: This service brings data into BigQuery for analytics, not for general unstructured object storage migration to Cloud Storage.
why other options are wrong.Datastream: Datastream is for real-time relational database CDC, not unstructured file storage.
why other options are wrong.Cloud SQL Export: This is a feature to back up a database, not a tool for migrating general on-premises storage arrays.

questions.questionText: Your data analytics team wants to automate the daily ingestion of marketing data from external SaaS platforms like Google Ads and YouTube directly into BigQuery. Which managed migration tool requires zero coding to set this up?

explanation.general explanation: BigQuery Data Transfer Service automates data movement into BigQuery on a scheduled basis. It natively supports integrating with Google SaaS applications (like Ads, YouTube) and third-party partners without requiring any custom coding.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Dataflow: Dataflow is a data processing service. While it can connect to APIs, it requires writing custom Apache Beam code, violating the 'zero coding' requirement.
why other options are wrong.Storage Transfer Service: This service moves data to Cloud Storage, not directly into structured BigQuery tables.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Dataprep: Cloud Dataprep is for visually cleaning and transforming data, not an automated ingestion connector for SaaS platforms.

questions.questionText: Your organization wants to modernize its legacy monolithic applications running on traditional VMs. You advise them to extract the application components and convert them into container images to run on GKE. Which Google Cloud system migration tool is specifically designed to automate this extraction and conversion process?

explanation.general explanation: Migrate to Containers (formerly Migrate for Anthos) is a tool that analyzes existing VM-based applications, extracts the OS, application data, and configurations, and packages them into container images ready to be deployed to GKE or Cloud Run.

why other options are wrong.Migrate to Virtual Machines: This tool lifts and shifts VMs to other VMs on Compute Engine. It does not modernize or convert them into containers.
why other options are wrong.Artifact Registry: Artifact Registry stores container images; it does not perform the migration or conversion of a VM into an image.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Build: Cloud Build is a CI/CD tool for compiling code into containers. It is not an automated migration tool for converting legacy VMs.

questions.questionText: You are designing an analytics pipeline and need to replicate transactional changes from an on-premises Oracle database into BigQuery in real-time. Which serverless Change Data Capture (CDC) migration tool should you use?

explanation.general explanation: Datastream is a serverless Change Data Capture (CDC) and replication service. It natively captures real-time data changes from operational databases (like Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and streams them to BigQuery or Cloud Storage.

why other options are wrong.Database Migration Service: DMS is for migrating a database to Cloud SQL or AlloyDB, not for streaming real-time CDC updates into an analytical data warehouse like BigQuery.
why other options are wrong.Storage Transfer Service: This service moves files, not real-time transactional database row changes.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Data Fusion: While Data Fusion can build CDC pipelines, Datastream is the purpose-built, native serverless tool specifically for Oracle/MySQL CDC to BigQuery.

questions.questionText: After migrating a fleet of 500 Linux VMs to Compute Engine, the operations team needs a management tool to centralize and automate the installation of security updates across the entire fleet. Which service should you advise them to use?

explanation.general explanation: OS Patch Management (a component of OS Config) provides a centralized mechanism to apply operating system patches across Compute Engine instances, helping operations teams automate security updates.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Deployment Manager: Deployment Manager provisions cloud infrastructure, it does not manage internal OS patches for running VMs.
why other options are wrong.Google Cloud Armor: Cloud Armor is a Web Application Firewall (WAF) for DDoS protection, not an OS patching tool.
why other options are wrong.Security Command Center: SCC provides visibility into security misconfigurations and vulnerabilities, but OS Patch Management is the tool that actually executes the OS updates.

questions.questionText: Which two external database sources are natively supported by Google Cloud Database Migration Service (DMS) for continuous replication to Cloud SQL? (Choose two)

explanation.general explanation: Database Migration Service (DMS) supports migrating from various relational database sources to Cloud SQL. It natively supports migrating MySQL and PostgreSQL workloads from on-premises, Amazon RDS, and other cloud providers.

why other options are wrong.Amazon DynamoDB: DynamoDB is a NoSQL database and is not supported by DMS.
why other options are wrong.On-premises Cassandra databases: Cassandra is a NoSQL wide-column store and is not supported by DMS for Cloud SQL migrations.
why other options are wrong.Google Cloud Firestore: Firestore is a NoSQL document database, not a source or target for relational DMS migrations.

questions.questionText: Before starting a mass migration, your enterprise needs to discover all current on-premises servers, map application dependencies, and estimate the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of moving to Google Cloud. Which Google Cloud tooling suite is designed for this assessment phase?

explanation.general explanation: Google Cloud Migration Center (which incorporates technologies like StratoZone) is the unified discovery and assessment platform. It helps you discover on-premises assets, map dependencies, and calculate the TCO of running those workloads in Google Cloud.

why other options are wrong.Migrate to Virtual Machines: This is the execution tool that actually moves the data and VMs, but it is not the primary discovery and TCO assessment tool.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Architecture Center: This is a documentation hub for reference architectures, not a software tool for scanning your local network.
why other options are wrong.Active Assist: Active Assist provides automated recommendations (like resizing a VM) for resources already running in GCP, not for assessing pre-migration on-premises environments.

questions.questionText: A developer needs to upload 5 GB of local log files from their laptop to a Cloud Storage bucket as a one-off task. Which simple command-line management tool should they use?

explanation.general explanation: The `gcloud storage cp` command (and the legacy `gsutil cp`) is the standard Google Cloud CLI tool for copying files directly from a local machine to a Cloud Storage bucket quickly and efficiently.

why other options are wrong.`bq load`: This command loads structured data into BigQuery tables, not unstructured files into Cloud Storage.
why other options are wrong.Storage Transfer Service: While STS can move on-premises data, it requires deploying an agent and is overkill for a one-off 5 GB transfer from a personal laptop.
why other options are wrong.Transfer Appliance: This is a physical shipping device used for petabyte-scale transfers, completely unsuited for a 5 GB laptop upload.

questions.questionText: Your company is migrating its entire infrastructure to Google Cloud. They want to retire their on-premises domain controllers but still need a native Active Directory environment for legacy Windows applications in the cloud. Which management service should they use?
options: Managed Service for Microsoft Active Directory
correctAnswers: Managed Service for Microsoft Active Directory

explanation.general explanation: Managed Service for Microsoft Active Directory (Managed Microsoft AD) provides a highly available, hardened Google Cloud service running actual Microsoft AD. It is the perfect migration target when you want to retire on-prem AD servers but still need AD for Windows workloads.

why other options are wrong.Google Cloud Directory Sync: GCDS is a tool that syncs users from on-prem AD to Google Workspace; it is not a replacement for a Domain Controller hosting AD services.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Identity: Cloud Identity is Google's native Identity Provider (IdP) for web apps and GCP console access. It does not provide the Kerberos/NTLM authentication required by legacy Windows domain-joined applications.
why other options are wrong.Identity-Aware Proxy: IAP is a zero-trust proxy for securing web apps, not an Active Directory replacement.

questions.questionText: To manage identities during a migration, your security team wants to keep the on-premises Microsoft Active Directory as the source of truth, but they need those user accounts to automatically appear in Google Cloud IAM. Which tooling provides this synchronization?
options: Managed Service for Microsoft Active Directory

explanation.general explanation: Google Cloud Directory Sync (GCDS) is a free tool provided by Google that syncs users, groups, and organizational units from your on-premises Microsoft Active Directory directly into Google Workspace/Cloud Identity.

why other options are wrong.Workload Identity Federation: This is used for authenticating external machine workloads (like AWS VMs or GitHub Actions) to Google Cloud APIs, not for syncing human user directories.
why other options are wrong.Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP): IAP enforces access control for web applications. It relies on the users already existing in Cloud Identity.
why other options are wrong.Managed Service for Microsoft Active Dir: This hosts an AD domain in the cloud; it is not the synchronization software used to bridge an on-premises AD to Google Cloud Identity.

questions.questionText: When using Google Cloud Datastream for real-time data migration and CDC, which two services are supported as native destinations to stream the data into? (Choose two)

explanation.general explanation: Datastream is a Change Data Capture (CDC) and replication service that natively streams changes from operational databases directly into Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery for analytics and integration purposes.

why other options are wrong.Cloud SQL: Datastream extracts from Cloud SQL (and other relational DBs) but does not natively write continuous replication streams back into another Cloud SQL database (Database Migration Service handles that).
why other options are wrong.Cloud Spanner: Datastream does not natively write CDC streams to Cloud Spanner without custom Dataflow pipelines.
why other options are wrong.Firestore: Firestore is a NoSQL document database and is not a native target for Datastream CDC output.

questions.questionText: Your enterprise has a legacy Oracle database. Due to extremely strict Oracle licensing restrictions, this database cannot run on virtualized hardware. To migrate this workload to Google Cloud, which specialized infrastructure solution should you use?

explanation.general explanation: Bare Metal Solution provides purpose-built, dedicated physical servers integrated with Google Cloud. It is designed specifically to host specialized workloads like Oracle databases that require hardware-level isolation for strict licensing compliance.

why other options are wrong.Compute Engine Custom Machine Types: Compute Engine provides virtual machines. Oracle's licensing often penalizes or prohibits running on virtualized multi-tenant public cloud infrastructure.
why other options are wrong.Google Cloud VMware Engine: GCVE provides virtualized VMware instances, which still violates strict physical hardware licensing rules for certain Oracle workloads.
why other options are wrong.AlloyDB for PostgreSQL: AlloyDB is a PostgreSQL-compatible database. While you might eventually refactor the application to use it, the question asks where to migrate the existing Oracle database under its current strict licensing.

questions.questionText: You are migrating a massive on-premises Apache Hadoop and Spark cluster to Google Cloud. You want to lift and shift the data processing jobs with minimal code changes. Which managed service provides the best migration target?

explanation.general explanation: Cloud Dataproc is Google Cloud's fully managed Hadoop and Spark service. It is the direct lift-and-shift migration target for existing on-premises Hadoop/Spark clusters, allowing you to run your existing code with minimal changes.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Dataflow: Dataflow uses the Apache Beam framework. Migrating to Dataflow would require completely rewriting the existing Hadoop MapReduce or Spark code.
why other options are wrong.BigQuery: BigQuery is a serverless data warehouse utilizing SQL. It cannot directly run raw Hadoop or Spark jobs.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Data Fusion: Data Fusion is a visual ETL interface, not an execution environment for lifting and shifting existing custom Hadoop code.

questions.questionText: When using the Migrate to Virtual Machines tool, what is the primary purpose of executing a 'Test Clone' before the final migration cutover?
options: To test if the VM successfully boots and runs in Google Cloud without impacting the live on-premises source VM.
To securely format and erase the data on the on-premises source VM.
To automatically convert the VM into a Docker container.
To permanently redirect all user network traffic to the cloud VM.
correctAnswers: To test if the VM successfully boots and runs in Google Cloud without impacting the live on-premises source VM.

explanation.general explanation: A 'Test Clone' in Migrate to Virtual Machines creates a copy of the migrating VM in Google Cloud for testing purposes. This allows you to verify that the OS, networking, and applications function correctly in GCP without touching or disrupting the live production VM running on-premises.

why other options are wrong.To securely format and erase the data on: Migrate to VMs never deletes your on-premises data; a test clone certainly does not.
why other options are wrong.To automatically convert the VM into a D: This is done by Migrate to Containers, not the Test Clone feature of Migrate to VMs.
why other options are wrong.To permanently redirect all user network: Redirecting traffic is part of the final 'Cutover' phase, not the isolated 'Test Clone' phase.

questions.questionText: Which two external cloud storage platforms are natively supported as direct data sources by Google Cloud Storage Transfer Service? (Choose two)

explanation.general explanation: Storage Transfer Service natively supports pulling data directly from Amazon S3, Microsoft Azure Blob Storage, and other HTTP/HTTPS locations into Google Cloud Storage.

why other options are wrong.Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Object Stora: While you could script a transfer using generic APIs, OCI is not natively listed as a primary supported STS source platform in the console.

questions.questionText: Your company has a dedicated 10 Gbps Cloud Interconnect connection. You need to migrate 100 TB of files from your on-premises network attached storage (NAS) to Cloud Storage. What is the most automated and reliable management tool for this?
options: Storage Transfer Service with on-premises agents
A bash script running `gcloud storage cp`
correctAnswers: Storage Transfer Service with on-premises agents

explanation.general explanation: Storage Transfer Service for on-premises data allows you to deploy software agents on your local network. These agents utilize your high-bandwidth connection (like Interconnect) to reliably and automatically move massive amounts of file data directly to Cloud Storage.

why other options are wrong.Transfer Appliance: Transfer Appliance is a physical device meant for when you DO NOT have sufficient network bandwidth. Since you have a 10 Gbps Interconnect, STS over the network is faster and easier.
why other options are wrong.A bash script running `gcloud storage cp: While possible, bash scripts lack the robust retry logic, parallelization, auditing, and managed dashboard tracking provided by Storage Transfer Service.
why other options are wrong.BigQuery Data Transfer Service: This service moves data into BigQuery, not unstructured file data into Cloud Storage.

questions.questionText: During a migration planning phase, you need a tool to discover the network dependencies of your on-premises virtual machines to ensure you migrate interconnected application tiers together. Which tool provides this dependency mapping?

explanation.general explanation: Migration Center (which incorporates StratoZone capabilities) can scan your on-premises environment to not only discover VMs but also map network dependencies between them. This helps group VMs into 'migration waves' to ensure interconnected apps move together.

why other options are wrong.VPC Flow Logs: VPC Flow Logs monitor traffic inside Google Cloud networks, not for assessing pre-migration on-premises networks.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Trace: Cloud Trace is a distributed tracing tool for application latency within Google Cloud, not for pre-migration infrastructure discovery.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Profiler: Cloud Profiler tracks CPU/RAM usage of specific code functions, entirely unrelated to infrastructure migration planning.

questions.questionText: You are migrating a legacy on-premises Teradata data warehouse to Google Cloud. You want a fully managed service that can extract the data securely and load it directly into BigQuery. Which service handles this specific migration?

explanation.general explanation: BigQuery Data Transfer Service provides a specialized Teradata migration feature. It uses an on-premises agent to connect to Teradata, extract the data, and load it directly into BigQuery.

why other options are wrong.Storage Transfer Service: This service moves unstructured files/objects to Cloud Storage, not structured warehouse tables to BigQuery.
why other options are wrong.Database Migration Service: DMS is for operational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle, not analytical data warehouses like Teradata.
why other options are wrong.Transfer Appliance: This is a physical shipping device for raw files, not an automated ETL extraction tool for Teradata schemas.

questions.questionText: You advise a team to completely rewrite their legacy monolithic application using Cloud Functions and Cloud Firestore to fully leverage cloud-native scalability. Which migration strategy does this represent?

explanation.general explanation: Re-architecting (or Refactoring) involves significantly changing or completely rewriting the application code to utilize cloud-native features (like serverless functions and managed NoSQL databases) for maximum scalability and performance.

why other options are wrong.Rehost / Lift and Shift: Lift and Shift involves moving the application exactly as-is (e.g., from an on-prem VM to a Compute Engine VM) without changing code.
why other options are wrong.Replatform / Lift and Optimize: Replatforming involves minor modifications, such as moving a self-managed database to a managed service like Cloud SQL, without a complete codebase rewrite.
why other options are wrong.Retain: Retain means keeping the application on-premises and not migrating it at all.

questions.questionText: When setting up the infrastructure to use the Migrate to Virtual Machines tool for moving VMs from an on-premises VMware vSphere environment to Google Cloud, which two components must be deployed and connected? (Choose two)
options: A Migrate Connector deployed in the on-premises vSphere environment.
A target Google Cloud project configured to receive the VMs.
A physical Transfer Appliance shipped to the on-premises data center.
A Cloud SQL instance to store VM metadata.
correctAnswers: A Migrate Connector deployed in the on-premises vSphere environment.
A target Google Cloud project configured to receive the VMs.

explanation.general explanation: To use Migrate to Virtual Machines, you must deploy a virtual appliance called the 'Migrate Connector' in your on-premises vSphere environment. This connector authenticates with and securely transmits data to the target Google Cloud project where the Compute Engine VMs will be instantiated.

why other options are wrong.A physical Transfer Appliance shipped to: Transfer Appliance is for offline data transfer, not live VM migrations.
ASM manages microservice communication, not the migration of traditional VMs.
why other options are wrong.A Cloud SQL instance to store VM metadat: Migrate to VMs manages its own metadata via its control plane; you do not need to provision Cloud SQL for it.

questions.questionText: After migrating several applications to Google Cloud, your operations team needs a centralized management tool to view system events, application errors, and administrative audit trails. Which tool in the operations suite should they use?

explanation.general explanation: Cloud Logging is the centralized management tool for collecting, storing, and analyzing text-based records, including system events, application logs, and Google Cloud Audit Logs.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Monitoring: Cloud Monitoring collects numerical metrics (like CPU % and Memory usage), not the text-based logs and audit trails.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Trace: Cloud Trace tracks request latency across microservices.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Profiler: Cloud Profiler analyzes CPU and memory consumption within specific application code functions.

questions.questionText: Your team is migrating an application that historically used a single, massive MySQL database. They have suffered severe performance issues due to database limits. To modernize the workload for infinite global scaling, which Google Cloud database service should they migrate to (requiring some application refactoring)?

explanation.general explanation: Cloud Spanner is a fully managed, globally distributed relational database that offers infinite horizontal scalability and strong consistency. It is the premier migration target when a traditional relational database (like MySQL) hits its vertical scaling limits.

why other options are wrong.Cloud SQL for MySQL: While a direct migration, Cloud SQL still represents a single primary node and has strict vertical scaling limits (RAM/CPU), which does not solve the fundamental performance limits mentioned.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Storage: Cloud Storage is an object store for files, not a relational database for querying.
why other options are wrong.Memorystore: Memorystore is an in-memory caching service (Redis/Memcached), not a persistent relational database.

questions.questionText: You want to migrate a PostgreSQL database currently hosted on Amazon RDS over to Google Cloud SQL. Which managed migration tool makes this cross-cloud database migration process the easiest?

explanation.general explanation: Database Migration Service (DMS) natively supports migrating PostgreSQL databases directly from Amazon RDS into Google Cloud SQL with continuous replication to minimize downtime.

why other options are wrong.Storage Transfer Service: This service migrates files and objects from S3 to Cloud Storage, not relational database rows to Cloud SQL.
why other options are wrong.BigQuery Data Transfer Service: This service moves data into BigQuery for analytics, not to Cloud SQL for operational workloads.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Dataflow: While you could write a custom ETL pipeline, DMS is the purpose-built, easy-to-use managed tool for homogenous database migrations.

questions.questionText: Your CIO wants to know exactly how much it will cost to run your current on-premises server fleet in Google Cloud. Which Migration Center feature will automatically analyze your machine utilization and output a precise cloud cost estimate?

explanation.general explanation: The TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) Assessment feature within Migration Center analyzes the CPU, RAM, and storage utilization of your discovered on-premises servers and maps them to the most cost-effective Google Cloud machine types, providing a detailed cost estimate.

why other options are wrong.VPC Flow Logs: VPC Flow Logs measure network traffic inside GCP, not the financial cost of migrating on-premises servers.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Billing Budget Alerts: Budget alerts notify you when your current GCP spend exceeds a threshold; they do not assess pre-migration on-premises hardware costs.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Profiler: Cloud Profiler analyzes code performance, not infrastructure billing estimates.

questions.questionText: Your organization uses Kubernetes extensively on-premises. As part of your migration strategy, you want a single management tool in Google Cloud that can view, monitor, and enforce security policies across both your remaining on-premises clusters and your new Google Cloud clusters. Which platform provides this?

explanation.general explanation: GKE Enterprise (formerly Anthos) is Google's hybrid and multi-cloud container management platform. It allows you to attach on-premises Kubernetes clusters and manage them centrally alongside Google Cloud GKE clusters through a single pane of glass.

why other options are wrong.Cloud Deployment Manager: This is an IaC tool for provisioning infrastructure, not a live fleet management platform for distributed Kubernetes clusters.
why other options are wrong.Migrate to Virtual Machines: This tool moves VMs to Compute Engine; it does not manage Kubernetes clusters.
why other options are wrong.Cloud Build: Cloud Build is a CI/CD service, not a Kubernetes cluster management and policy enforcement tool.
